(B) 7pm to 9pm
(C) 2pm to 4pm
(D) 4pm to 7pm

Given these points, we can see that Sarah was occupied from 11am to 7pm. The art show was closed by 9pm, so she couldn't have gone after that time.

- (A) 11am to 2pm: Sarah was at the office during this time.
- (B) 7pm to 9pm: Sarah was at the electronic store until 7pm, so she couldn't have gone to the art show during this time.
- (C) 2pm to 4pm: Sarah was at the library during this time.
- (D) 4pm to 7pm: Sarah was at the electronic store during this time.

The only time Sarah was free to go to the art show was between 7pm and 9pm, but since the art show closed at 9pm, the only feasible time she could have gone to the art show is just before it closed, which would be between 7pm and 9pm.

Answer: (B)
